user.title: SmartHeat login
user.description: Sign in with your SmartHeat account. The setup then detects your heating system; you only confirm and choose your rooms.

tenant.title: Select installation
tenant.description: Your account has several heating installations. Which one would you like to set up?

heating.title: Heating integration
heating.description: Several supported heating integrations are set up. Which one controls the heating to be regulated?

system.title: Your heating system
system.description: Heating system found via {integration}. How does the heat reach your rooms? This determines the local safety limits, so please choose carefully.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Choose the room temperature sensors (several are averaged) and the entity holding your desired temperature. A thermostat can be both. Thermostats and sensors with the device class "Temperature" are offered.

plant_values.title: Heating values

advanced.name: Advanced: measurements for evaluations
advanced.description: Optional. Pre-filled where detected. Energy counters need the state class 'total_increasing'.

summary.title: Summary

data.confirm_stale: I checked the sources without an update for more than 6 hours
data.confirm_deviation: I checked the room sensors deviating by more than 3 K
data.confirm_write_role_unmatched: I checked that these entities belong to the chosen heating circuit
data.confirm_poll_interval: I checked the heating integration's update interval

setup_timeout.title: No response from the add-on
setup_timeout.description: The Heizungsbruecke add-on did not report ready within 3 minutes. Please check its log (Settings → Add-ons → Heizungsbruecke → Log).

progress.setup: Setting up SmartHeat: requesting access, configuring and starting the add-ons, waiting for the add-on to report ready (up to 3 minutes).

error.invalid_response: The SmartHeat server sent an unreadable answer. Please try again later.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SmartHeat service
error.no_tenants: Subscribe on our website to get access to our heating control server.
error.profile_combination_unsupported: This combination is not supported yet
error.entity_wrong_integration: This entity does not belong to the chosen heating integration
error.entity_wrong_installation: This entity belongs to another installation of the heating integration
error.entity_unavailable: This entity currently has no value
error.not_numeric: This entity does not provide a number
error.out_of_range: The value is outside the physically plausible range
error.duplicate_entity: The same entity is used for two roles
error.wrong_domain: This entity does not fit this field
error.zone_is_room_target: The heating zone cannot also provide the desired room temperature: SmartHeat writes the parallel shift into the zone. Choose a room thermostat or sensor for the desired temperature
error.room_sensors_required: Choose at least one room temperature sensor
error.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.state_class_expected_measurement: Expected state class 'measurement' (entities without any state_class are also rejected)
error.state_class_expected_total_increasing: Expected state class 'total_increasing'. Counters with 'total' cannot be used.

abort.not_supervisor: This integration only works on a Home Assistant installation with Supervisor (Home Assistant OS or Home Assistant Supervised), because it provisions real MQTT credentials and configures companion add-ons via the Supervisor API.
abort.already_configured: This installation is already set up. To change it, open the SmartHeat entry and choose ⋮ → Reconfigure.
abort.single_instance_allowed: SmartHeat is already set up in this Home Assistant. To change it, open the SmartHeat entry and choose ⋮ → “Reconfigure”.
abort.no_verified_profiles: No verified profile is currently available for your heating system. Please try again later or contact support.
abort.addon_missing: The add-on {addon} is not installed. Install it from the SmartHeat add-on repository, then start the setup again.
abort.addon_ambiguous: The add-on {addon} is installed more than once. Remove the duplicate installation, then start the setup again.
abort.addon_outdated: The add-on {addon} is outdated (installed {installed}, required {required}). Update it, then start the setup again.
abort.supervisor_unavailable: The Supervisor is not reachable. Please try again later.
abort.no_supported_integration: No supported heating integration is set up in Home Assistant. Supported: {supported}.
abort.no_heating_circuit: {integration} does not provide a complete heating circuit (heating curve, minimum flow temperature and heating limit are required).
abort.wrong_account: This account does not include the installation of this entry.
abort.reconfigure_first: Please complete the setup first: open the SmartHeat entry and choose ⋮ → Reconfigure.
abort.reconfigure_successful: SmartHeat was reconfigured. Your access credentials stayed the same.{notes}
abort.reconfigure_successful_new_credentials: SmartHeat was reconfigured. New access credentials were issued, because the add-ons had no complete ones.{notes}

init.title: SmartHeat options
init.description: Changes here need no sign-in. SmartHeat restarts the Heizungsbruecke add-on afterwards. Thermostats and sensors with the device class "Temperature" are offered.

data.hint_raumfuehler: Notify about a failed room sensor
data.hint_manueller_eingriff: Notify about a manual change of the heating curve or the parallel shift
data.hint_quellwechsel: Notify about a changed temperature source

options.heizkoerper: Radiators: metal panels on the walls, often under windows
options.fussbodenheizung: Underfloor heating: the floor gets warm, no radiators on the walls

complete_setup.title: SmartHeat: complete the setup for {tenant}
complete_setup.description: The setup of {tenant} is incomplete or comes from an older version. The heating control is paused, the heating keeps its last values. Open Settings → Devices & services → SmartHeat, choose ⋮ → Reconfigure and sign in. Your access credentials stay the same.

common.done_status_datenfehler: The add-on reports a data error ({grund}). SmartHeat regulates as soon as the values are valid again; details on the SmartHeat device.
common.done_status_notbetrieb: The add-on cannot reach the SmartHeat server right now and runs in emergency mode. It reconnects on its own; the status is shown on the SmartHeat device.
common.done_status_abo_inaktiv: Your subscription is currently inactive. SmartHeat resumes as soon as it is active.
common.done_status_abo_beendet: Your subscription has ended. The system keeps its base values until the subscription is renewed.
common.done_supervision: The add-on watchdog could not be enabled, please check the log.
common.profile_rejected: The SmartHeat server rejected the chosen heating profile. Please choose another combination or contact support.
common.origin_weather: {role}: {entity} (weather service, your heating has no outdoor sensor)
common.warning_stale: No update for more than 6 hours: {entities}
common.warning_deviation: More than 3 K away from the other room sensors: {entities}
common.warning_write_role_unmatched: Not recognised as part of the chosen heating circuit: {entities}. SmartHeat will write to these entities.
common.warning_poll_interval: The heating integration only polls its values every {entities}. SmartHeat may then not see its own changes in time and treat them as a manual change. Please set the heating integration's update interval to 30 minutes or less.
common.notifications_phones: SmartHeat notifies the selected phones when the control stops, a room sensor fails or a battery runs low.
common.notifications_no_phones: No Home Assistant companion app was found, so SmartHeat can only show its important messages (e.g. when the control stops) as notifications in Home Assistant. Install the companion app on a phone to also receive push messages, e.g. about a failed room sensor or a low battery.
common.addon_ambiguous: The add-on {addon} is installed more than once. Please remove the duplicate installation.
common.addon_outdated: The add-on {addon} is outdated (installed {installed}, required {required}). Please update it.
common.supervisor_unavailable: The Supervisor is not reachable. Please try again.
common.provisioning_failed: The SmartHeat server could not issue access credentials. Please try again later.
common.invalid_provisioning_response: The SmartHeat server returned an incomplete setup response. Please try again later or contact support.
common.setup_unexpected: Unexpected error during setup, see the Home Assistant log.
common.new_credentials: New access credentials will be issued.
common.profile_update_failed: The SmartHeat server could not change the heating profile. Please try again later.
common.options_addon_failed: The Heizungsbruecke add-on could not be updated. Please check the Supervisor and try again.
common.options_restored: The previous Heizungsbrücke settings have been restored.
common.options_restore_failed: The previous Heizungsbrücke settings could not be restored. Please save the options again.
common.removal_incomplete: SmartHeat was removed, but not every step succeeded:
common.rollback_first_setup: The SmartHeat setup was cancelled. The add-ons were stopped and the issued credentials revoked.
common.rollback_reconfigure: “Reconfigure” was cancelled. The previous add-on settings and heating profile have been restored.
common.rollback_first_setup_incomplete: The SmartHeat setup was cancelled, but not every step of the rollback succeeded:
common.rollback_reconfigure_incomplete: “Reconfigure” was cancelled, but not every step of the restore succeeded:
common.open_step_supervisor: The Supervisor was unreachable. Please stop the add-ons Heizungsbrücke and Cloudflared Access TCP-Bridge manually under Settings → Add-ons.
common.open_step_foreign_tenant: The add-ons belong to another SmartHeat installation and were left untouched.
common.open_step_no_sign_off: Heizungsbrücke did not confirm the sign-off and was stopped anyway. Please check heating curve and zone in the manufacturer's app: boost values (curve 1.5, shift 25) may have been left in place.
common.open_step_stop: An add-on could not be stopped. Please stop it manually under Settings → Add-ons.
common.open_step_revoke: The credentials could not be revoked on the SmartHeat server. They will be replaced at the next setup.
common.open_step_clear: The credentials could not be removed from the add-on options. Please uninstall the add-ons if SmartHeat is no longer used.
common.open_step_profile: The previous heating profile could not be restored on the SmartHeat server. Please run “Reconfigure” again.
common.open_step_addons: The previous add-on settings could not be restored. Please run “Reconfigure” again.
